en-US.longDescription:
Glaxnimate is an open-source vector animation and motion design desktop application.
Features:
- Tweening
- Precompositions
- Time Stretching
- Motion Along Path
- Shape Modifiers
- Text Support
- Animated Gradients
- Raster to Vector
- Scripting Support
Supported file formats:
- Lottie
- Animated SVG
- Animated WebP
- Animated Vector Drawables
- RIVE
- Video Export
- Spritesheet Export
en-US.name: Glaxnimate

zh-CN.longDescription:
Glaxnimate 是一款开源的矢量动画和动作设计桌面应用程序。
特点
- 过渡
- 预合成
- 时间拉伸
- 沿路径运动
- 形状修改器
- 文本支持
- 动画渐变
- 光栅到矢量
- 脚本支持
支持的文件格式
- Lottie
- 动画 SVG
- 动画 WebP
- Animated Vector Drawable
- RIVE
- 导出视频
- 导出精灵表
